Brotli compression format, ported from brotli.go.

Backend is nbrotli (hard require, pure Nim, no C bindings). Decode coverage is full (q=0..11, large window 10..30). Encode is store-only in nbrotli v1, so compress buffers and uses compressStore; output is always decodable by the reference brotli CLI but larger than quality-compressed output.

../io, ../types, ../registry

Brotli = object
  quality*: int              ## 0..11, stored for future real encoder
  windowBits*: int           ## 10..24 for store encoder
